name: VFX Football League
tagline: The league where post-production clocks off and kicks off.
description: The VFX Football League is a short-season 8-a-side league for people who work in the visual effects industry. Studio teams, eight to eleven games, one trophy. Currently running in London.
comment_sofascore: Widget IDs verified against widgets.sofascore.com. To roll the site over to a new season, update seasonId (and tournamentId/group if Sofascore renames the group) here, nothing else needs touching.
comment_instagram: Create a free feed at https://behold.so, connect @vfxleague.london, then paste the feed ID here. Leave blank and the Media page shows a tidy fallback card instead of a broken embed.
comment_contact: Get a free access key at https://web3forms.com. Paste it here. Leave blank and the contact page falls back to a mailto link.
comment_portal: Team portal (/portal/ and /admin/). supabaseUrl is the Project URL and supabaseKey the PUBLISHABLE key from Supabase > Project Settings > API Keys. Both are public by design: what each person can do is enforced by the database rules in supabase/schema.sql. Leave both blank and the portal shows a 'not set up yet' card. turnstileSiteKey (optional) is the Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the spam check on sign-in; set it only after switching on CAPTCHA protection in Supabase (see supabase/README.md). positions lists what captains can pick; the database also accepts defender and midfielder if you add them.
